name: mipnerf-garden

tools.name: COLMAP
tools.role: poses: one OPENCV camera, exhaustive matching, the mapper

tools.name: gsplat
tools.role: the splat: 30000 steps, 10.3 min for the whole chain

tools.name: rq_pipeline.scenes
tools.role: the chain, the alignment, the record

proxy.method: below 0.25 m, the visible gaussian centres' top surface on a 0.02 m grid (each cell the 90th percentile of its centres, then the median of its 5x5 neighbours, small holes filled from their neighbours): the ground; at or above it, the centres as an occupancy volume on 0.05 m voxels, the exposed faces of the occupied ones: what stands, with air beneath a table top; not a dense reconstruction

alignment.source: the largest plane through the visible centres (RANSAC) as the floor, its normal to +z, most of the scene above it, its centroid at the origin; scale 0.56 m per COLMAP unit, declared by the caller

gap.method: visible gaussian centres (opacity >= 0.5) inside the proxy's extent grown by 0.5 m, to the proxy surface by Open3D ray casting; proxy surface samples to the nearest visible centre anywhere by k-d tree; distances in metres

notes: the proxy is the visible surface itself (the ground's top on a grid, what stands above it as voxels): the gap measures its fidelity to the splat, not to the world
no dense reconstruction: COLMAP's patch-match needs CUDA and the 2DGS chain waits on the WSL machine (docs/78 §3)
the colour is the zeroth harmonic; the higher harmonics stay in the file

course.source: laid out by the operator (2026-09-23): under the table south to north at x=0.5, the line farthest from every leg (0.35 m clear); it crosses the base beams where they meet, 5-10 cm high
